map.。房地产交易受当地限购、信贷与税费政策影响，各城市执行口径存在差异，实际操作请以: . Real estate transactions are affected by local purchase restrictions, credit and tax policies, and enforcement rules differ between cities; for actual operations, follow the signed contract, the appraisal report and the regulations of the competent authority, and consult a professional valuer or broker for major decisions.
map.低于 10 分视为部分违规需补正，低于 6 分严重违规，对方可申请执行异议或申请: A score below 10 counts as a partial violation needing correction; below 6 is a serious violation, and the counterparty may apply for an enforcement objection or request a re-assessment.
map.司法房地产评估合规性检查工具，从鉴定主体资格、评估程序规范、评估标准适用、评估报: Judicial real estate appraisal compliance check tool, scoring across 4 dimensions: qualification of the appraisal entity, procedural compliance, applicability of appraisal standards and quality of the appraisal report.
map.合规评分低会怎样？: What happens if the compliance score is low?

map.填写「8. 拍卖保留价是否合理」。: Fill in "8. Whether the auction reserve price is reasonable".
map.当事人异议时对照检查项补充材料。: When a party objects, supplement the materials against the checklist items.
map.拍卖保留价算检查项吗？: Is the auction reserve price a checklist item?
map.法院委托评估前自查程序是否合规。: Self-check procedural compliance before a court-commissioned appraisal.
map.算，保留价设定是否合理是司法评估合规的重要一环，需与评估值挂钩并留痕。: Calculate. Whether the reserve price is set reasonably is an important part of judicial appraisal compliance; it must be linked to the appraised value and documented.
map.评估机构内部质控按八项打分。: The appraisal organisation scores itself on eight items for internal quality control.
map.：若评估师应回避未回避、未现场勘验、方法明显不当，合计低于 6 分则严重违规，评: : if the appraiser failed to recuse themselves, skipped the on-site inspection or used a clearly inappropriate method, a total below 6 is a serious violation and the result cannot be relied on, requiring a fresh appraisal.
map.：鉴定主体资格、评估师回避、委托程序、现场勘验、评估方法、报告规范、评估时点、拍: : the qualification of the appraisal entity, appraiser recusal, commissioning procedure, on-site inspection, appraisal method, report standards, valuation date and auction reserve price are each scored 0-2, maximum 16. A score of 14 or above is compliant; in the example all eight score 2, giving 16, which is compliant.
